adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /crm/leads?page_size=1&page_num=1, matching the pinned validator.
Native category is crm (source Productivity/Marketing; Marketing is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist).
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Writes, MongoDB match_filter_dict JSON encoding, and /created polling endpoints are omitted.
Optional pageSize, pageNum, startDate, and endDate bind to page_size, page_num, start_date, and end_date. match_filter_dict/sort_dict JSON encoding is omitted.
Returns raw Ambivo JSON under data.
Official GET /crm/contacts has page_size but no page_num, matching pinned input. Optional startDate/endDate bind to start_date/end_date.
Returns the raw Ambivo contact array or object under data.
Optional pageSize and pageNum bind to page_size and page_num. Returns raw Ambivo JSON under data.
POST /crm/leads. Native omits tags, SSN, and social profile arrays.
PATCH /crm/leads/{lead_id}. Unset optional fields are omitted.
GET /crm/leads/created with optional ISO start_date/end_date.
GET /crm/leads/status_updated with optional ISO start_date/end_date.
POST /crm/contacts. Native omits tags, SSN, and social profile arrays.
PATCH /crm/contacts/{contact_id}. Unset optional fields are omitted.
GET /crm/contacts/created with optional ISO start_date/end_date.
GET /crm/contacts/status_updated with optional ISO start_date/end_date.
GET /crm/accounts with optional page_size. match_filter_dict omitted.
POST /crm/accounts. Native omits tags and social profile arrays.
PATCH /crm/accounts/{account_id}. Unset optional fields are omitted.
GET /crm/deals with optional page_size and created-date range.
POST /crm/opportunities. Official deal-create path.
POST /crm/tasks. Native omits action_data and tags arrays.
PATCH /crm/tasks/{task_id}. Unset optional fields are omitted.
DELETE /crm/tasks/{task_id}.
